question:
Select the option that rectifies the underlined spelling error.

The panel __submited__ the findings to the ministry.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"submitted"** is the correct spelling and means to present or propose something formally for consideration or judgment. (प्रस्तुत किया)

 
 
• **Example: **The student submitted her research paper on time.
 
 
 
• The incorrect spelling **"submitad"** is likely a typographical error and does not carry any meaning in English. (कोई अर्थ नहीं है)
 
• The incorrect spelling **"submitd"** is missing a letter and is not a valid word in English. (कोई अर्थ नहीं है)
 
• The incorrect spelling **"sumited"** is also a misspelling and does not convey the intended meaning. (कोई अर्थ नहीं है)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
